exam.name: ITIL 4 Foundation
exam.prerequisites: None. No application, no experience audit, no mandatory training.
exam.note: Blueprint weights below are the official question counts per learning outcome, summing to 40.

modules.name: Key Concepts of Service Management
modules.blurb: Value, outcomes, costs, risks, utility and warranty — the vocabulary everything else is built on.

modules.name: The ITIL Guiding Principles
modules.blurb: Seven principles. Heavily tested, and the questions are applied, not definitional.

modules.name: The Four Dimensions
modules.blurb: Organizations and people, information and technology, partners and suppliers, value streams and processes.

modules.name: The Service Value System
modules.blurb: How the components fit together, and what governance and continual improvement do inside it.

modules.name: The Service Value Chain
modules.blurb: Six activities: plan, improve, engage, design and transition, obtain/build, deliver and support.

modules.name: 15 Practices — Purpose and Key Terms
modules.blurb: Recall level only. Includes release management and deployment management — your lane.

modules.name: 7 Practices — In Detail
modules.blurb: The heaviest section by far. Change enablement, incident, problem, service request, service desk, SLM, continual improvement.
